anchor_compliance: §16.2 permanent anchor; all falsifiers BIDIRECTIONAL; random-control R1 mandatory; NO BTR (best-test-rationalization) — pre-register only

falsifiers.name: closed-loop convergence
falsifiers.claim: Loop converges to attractor (mind.tension rolling std ratio steps 50-100 vs 0-50 < 0.5)
falsifiers.BIDIRECTIONAL_check: PASS only valid if random-control R1 trajectory does NOT also converge with same threshold; if R1 also converges -> result is GATE-clamping artifact, not signal

falsifiers.name: BOLD prediction varies meaningfully per CLM input
falsifiers.claim: BOLD vertex pattern from CLM-derived input differs from BOLD from random-text input (cosine similarity < 0.7)
falsifiers.BIDIRECTIONAL_check: report similarity in BOTH directions (CLM->random AND random->CLM); also test random-text vs random-text baseline

falsifiers.name: tension_link feedback causes CLM hidden-state shift > random injection
falsifiers.claim: ΔH (CLM hidden state shift between step_t and step_t+1 with TRIBE v2 feedback) > ΔH with random 5ch injection by > 1σ
falsifiers.decision_threshold: effect size d > 0.5 = PASS; 0.2-0.5 = PARTIAL; < 0.2 = FAIL
falsifiers.BIDIRECTIONAL_check: test BOTH 'TRIBE feedback > random' AND 'random > TRIBE feedback' (genuine bidirectional null); report both

falsifiers.name: 5ch tension <-> cortical region mapping consistency
falsifiers.claim: Proposed mapping (DMN<->WHAT, FPN<->WHY, salience<->TRUST, visual<->WHERE, auditory<->WHO) shows consistent vertex-level activation across runs (mean Pearson r >= 0.5 across 10 runs)
falsifiers.BIDIRECTIONAL_check: also test ALTERNATE mappings (random permutation of 5ch <-> 5 ROIs) and report effect size relative to permutation null; honest caveat: anima-specific mapping is post-hoc unless mapping fixed before run

falsifiers.name: closed-loop verdict differs from open-loop
falsifiers.claim: Framing E (closed) trajectory diverges from Framing A (open) trajectory at step 100 (cosine similarity < 0.6)
falsifiers.decision_threshold: cos < 0.6 = PASS (feedback matters); 0.6-0.8 = PARTIAL; > 0.8 = FAIL (feedback negligible)
falsifiers.BIDIRECTIONAL_check: ALSO measure 'open vs random-control' gap; if open-vs-closed is similar to random-vs-random, then no real signal regardless of cos value

control_arms_mandatory.name: random-tension control
control_arms_mandatory.spec: uniform-random 5ch in same dynamic range; same 100 steps

control_arms_mandatory.name: shuffled-feedback control
control_arms_mandatory.spec: across-step shuffle of TRIBE feedback; tests timing

control_arms_mandatory.name: open-loop control
control_arms_mandatory.spec: Framing A (no feedback); same input distribution

btr_block: Pre-registered thresholds frozen as of 2026-05-02; any post-hoc threshold change requires explicit btr_change.json with rationale and reviewer sign-off
minimum_pass_for_h1_publish: F-CT-1 PASS AND F-CT-2 PASS AND F-CT-3 not FAIL AND F-CT-5 PASS; F-CT-4 may remain exploratory
